Results.ReviewText: Got my 570 a week ago and absolutely love it. I was able to make the perfect brisket. Today pulled pork. This smoker does awesome in the shade on a hot day in Houston but had trouble regulating the smoking temp in direct sunlight. Other issue is with the wifire portion of the smoker.  If you open the app and view the temp on an Android phone, exit the app leaving the app running in the background.  Then go back into the app, the temps are not shown and app appears to freeze.  You have to exit and close the app and relaunch the app.  My suggestion is to always exit and close the app when viewing and adjusting settings on your smoker via phone app.  Lastly the notification for the probe temp being reach can be delayed. Small issues that I can live with and easily fixed by Traeger.  Overall the best grill I have owned.

Let me say this first, the food has been great off this grill. The grill itself was easy to assemble and almost operated as it should.

Now for the reason behind the 1star. The temperatures that the digital read out shows are way off! At lower temps (180) it was off by 20-50 degrees. And at higher temps (275) it was between 50-100 degrees off! Not a windy day, sunny, and low 90’s outside. I used two different oven thermometers and a separate digital probe and the grill was definitely off. 

I had so many issues with customer service during the ordering process that I have not called them yet about this problem. I’m actually dreading it. For $1,000 this holiday be an issue but as I’ve since found out it is an issue and we’ll complained about amongst Traeger groups on Reddit and other services. 

I would’ve returned this grill but of course the fine print states it must be in its original packaging and you are responsible for the return shipping. It was such a masterful artwork of packaging that no one could get it back together.
Results.Title: Buyer Beware.

Heats quickly and gets back to temp fast when you have to open the lid
Connects to your phone for easy controls (my husbands favorite feature)

Easy to clean

Cons:
We honestly can't think of any.

A few of our favorite recipes so far: meatloaf, brats philly style, lasagna, and fajitas. All super yummy and cooked perfect. Already talked a few friends into purchasing their own after backyard barbecues.

Pellet sensor, not sure why you cant have a pellets low warning on the above mentioned app?

Results.ReviewText: Just when I thought I couldn’t love my Traeger any more,  the wifire came out and absolutely changed the game! the peace of mind checking on the eats while out and about is unrivaled. 6 stars for the upgrade!
Results.Title: Game. Changer.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I’ve already used this grill for several cooks ...big and small.   The D2 drive does just what it was hyped up to do....it gets hot faster, maintains temps even better than the previous model and has an unbelievable recovery rate after the grill is opened to check on food.   This grill gets up to temp faster than our standard oven in our kitchen.   I’m 6’3” so I also greatly apprceiated the taller legs on this grill bringing the grilling area up to a comfortable height for even tall fellas.   The grilling space itself has an obvious increase in height also.   This makes those “Beer Can Chickens” even easier to fit in.   I can’t say enough about the Wifire technology which lets me monitor and control my grill whether I’m on the couch or out on the tractor putting food plots in on the farm.  With a quick glance Traeger has kept the classic look to this grill but managed to pack in all these great new features.   This summer is going to be a blast cooking for all my friends and family on my new Pro 780.   Thanks for another great product Traeger Team!
Results.Title: The Pro Series got even better!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
I've been using the pro series for years, and when the new ones came out I knew I had to cook on it. WOW... those aren't my words, those are the words of everyone who's eaten off it since I got it. One of my favorite aspects of the new pro series ( there are so many) is the Wi-Fire technology. I travel allot of work and my wife is always wanting to cook, but she gets busy and forgets. So all I have her do is turn the Pro on and I can control everything from my phone. I text her when to put the meat on, and text her when to pull it off. 

Can't say enough good things about Traeger and their customer service! Family for life.
Results.Title: Game Changer

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: I am absolutely amazed with this Grill. The unbelievable taste of the food that comes out for this Grill is amazing. In the things that you can cook on this Grill is shocking. One of my favorite things to cook on a Traeger is pizza. Absolutely unbelievable!!!
Results.Title: Unbelievable!!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using the new Pro 780 for a month now and have been very impressed with the performance so far. As a long term Traeger user, the new D2 grills are an improvement in just about every area. I live in a climate with cold winters and the even in sub zero temperatures, the new Pro quickly got up to searing temperature, and did an amazing job of maintaining temperature after opening and now closing the lid. Would definitely recommend the new Pro or any of the New D2 controller grills to first time buyers or seasoned Traeger users looking for an upgrade
Results.Title: D2 is everything and more!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText:
I am so excited with my new Traeger. This is my very first Traeger and I am blown away at how simple and approachable it is. I usually let my husband do all the grilling. The uncontrollable open flame, the burnt meats, the need to incessantly lift the lid to check the goods, it's always been too overwhelming for me and since I am generally making salads or sides inside, it's hard to keep up with it all. This grill has made grilling something I now enjoy, shoot I actually LOVE!
The WiFire technology gives me peace of mind and allows me to feel the freedom to focus on the other aspects of the meal I am preparing. I love that I have complete and utter control over the temperature of the grill and I can easily track the temperature of whatever I am cooking. Smoking is a new endeavor for me and I am pretty certain I am obsessed. Who knew it could be so simple! I highly recommend this grill, especially to the novice who might otherwise be intimidated by grilling
Results.Title: This Lady is Grilling for the First Time EVER

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had mine for a few months now, and it’s very quickly become my very favorite way to cook outdoors! Changing the pelleats is SO easy and it heats up in no time at all!
Results.Title: The new design takes everything to the next level!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: I have used a few different Traegers in the past and was very excited to try the new Pro series with the new technology. Immediately I noticed it heats up faster, and the temp bounces back very quickly when I open the grill lid. And the Wifire technology is a total game changer. For anyone who has been afraid to grill, this is the grill for you. There is nothing like the wood-fired flavor you get from a Traeger. I cook EVERYTHING on mine!
Results.Title: Loving my Traeger Pro 575 Pellet Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Bought my 780 pro and the food cooked so evenly and very juicy!
Results.Title: Great features!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
This things a beast! 
Such an impressive machine that barely needs an operator. From the WiFire to the D2 motor the grill can handle whatever you throw into it and the fact you can upload step by step recipes onto the app and reflects on the grill is just awesome. Everything from salmon filet to brisket has came out perfect. Traeger truly changed the game. Thank you!
Results.Title: WorkHorse

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I took delivery of my Traeger Pro 575 upon release and was immediately impressed by the solid construction of the grill, then I put it to use and was blown away by the range of new features it boasts. First off, I'm a big fan of the WiFire technology and being able to control my grill via cell phone or tablet. The Pro 575 also gets to temperature extremely quick and will bounce back to temperature equally as fast when opened to flip or baste the food I'm cooking, thanks to the D2 direct drive and Turbo Temp feature. I can't recommend this grill enough. Hats off to Traeger for producing such a quality product, that is built to make wood fire cooking simple and easy.
Results.Title: Can't go wrong!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I've had my New Pro 575 Grill for a while now and gotta say I am impressed!  Up to temp super fast, recovers just as fast!  All the Tech is gaming changing for using a pellet grill!  This thing will be getting a workout this Summer...!!!
Results.Title: Wow...!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I've had my grill for about 2 months now and love how easy it is to use. I love the probe that tells the temperature so you know when the food is done. I've made chicken, steak, pork chops, and salmon and everything comes out delicious with a great smokey flavor. I highly recommend this grill!
Results.Title: Easy to use!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I’ve had my grill for a few weeks now and I absolutely love it! The new auger/fan setup along with the thicker walls and lid are keeping my temps spot on. The speed this thing heats up now is incredible too!! cant wait to make some jerky!!
Results.Title: Love my grill!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
Having owned several pellet smokers in the past, each having their shortfalls, this NEW Traeger Pro 575 addressed all the shortfalls and took experience to the next level
Traegers upgraded features included the Wifire feature, which allows you to control your smoker from any where with your phone, and with hundreds of recipes at your disposal using the free Traeger App, how cool is that?
Traeger also upgraded the Direct Drive D2, this helps provide a more consistent temperature during your cooks.... and what blew me away was, how fast it came up to temp. From a cold start the grill reached 450F in 8minutes.... WOW!!!
If you are on the fence for a NEW grill, you will not be disapointed with a Traeger Pro 575!!
Results.Title: Traeger Pro 575 Next Level Grilling Experience

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I've been using my Pro 575 for a few weeks now and am totally in love with it.  It heats up quickly and keeps me informed of the progress via the mobile app no matter where I am.  The flavor is amazing.  Always a crowd pleaser!
Results.Title: Flexible quality!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: This is my first pellet grill and I'm in LOVE!!! The Pro 780 is the perfect grill for anyone who has ever been intimidated by grilling.  Traeger makes everything so easy for you, especially with the WiFire function and app!  I basically set it and forget it and let the grill DO.ITS.THANG!  Buy this grill and you will be a grilling/smoking pro in not time and everyone's best friend! I highly recommend getting the folding front shelf and the magnetic hooks for your bbq tools.
